_comment: botl.c bot() with disp.botlx and wintty.c render_status(): a dwarvish Archeologist with the time option goes to the Sokoban entry level, starts a wizard-mode teleport, turns autodescribe off and getloc_usemenu on in getpos(), and picks a boulder from the two-page 'a' menu. The menu's dismissal runs docrt() while windows.c select_menu() keeps gb.bot_disabled raised, so disp.botlx is still set when getpos()'s nxtc flush_screen(0) reaches bot(). BL_RESET redraws every status field, leaving the terminal cursor after the last field of the bottom line while getpos() waits. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
